name: IT team · reconcile demo/up.sh contract with the card text: provider list has `none`, not `ollama`; a bad --ref falls back to `:latest`, not `:demo`
description:
Two places where the implemented `demo/up.sh` contract differs from the text written in cards `2639c296` / `716c63f8`. Both are deliberate and were declared in the delivery comments; this card exists so a reviewer can rule on them instead of them being silently forgotten.

D1 — the provider list has 8 rows but not the same 8.
`demo/up.sh:66-86` (`usage_providers()`) prints: openai, deepseek, gemini, openrouter, mistral, groq, custom, **none**.
`716c63f8` asks for: openai, deepseek, gemini, openrouter, mistral, groq, **ollama**, custom.
The script documents Ollama as an instance of `custom` (`:80-82`: "A local Ollama or any other OpenAI-compatible server is used as the `custom` provider"), and `none` is a real value `demo/.env` accepts. So the script is self-consistent, but `716c63f8`'s check "stdout contains all 8 presets incl. ollama" will fail if taken literally.

D2 — an unusable `--ref` falls back to `:latest`, not `:demo`.
`2639c296` ACCEPTANCE says `--ref nonsense` resolves to `:demo`. The implementation resolves `nonsense` to `codxjuniorai/codx-junior:nonsense` (it is a legal Docker tag) and only falls back to `DEFAULT_TAG` (`:latest`) for values with spaces/punctuation. Asserted by `demo/tests/test_up.sh:96-99`.

DECIDE (product owner, one line each):
- Add an `ollama` row to `usage_providers()` (it is a distinct preset in the README table) **or** amend `716c63f8` to accept `custom` + `none`.
- Keep `:latest` as the fallback **or** change `DEFAULT_TAG` to `:demo`.

Do not change `resolve_image()` behaviour without also updating `demo/tests/test_up.sh` — the harness asserts what ships today, and both cards are in Review against it.

Blocks nothing: both cards are reviewable as implemented. This only closes the wording gap.
